title: 第9章 凌家龙卫第10章 无冤无仇
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 真武圣地
天空上屹立着一座城堡般的座驾，四处乃是六十四金甲帝卫，座驾前方乃是八头上古凶兽麒麟，在其身后的是一座晶壁辉煌的宫殿，俯视整个真武圣地
“这就是上界的大人吗？好可怕”
真武道场上，无数弟子被这股无形的威压压到不能抬头，只能低着头暗道
随着就是真武圣地修为低下的弟子受不住纷纷吐血倒地
“还请大人高抬贵手”
武鸿升见状自己的弟子纷纷倒下，看想虚空的宫殿道，不敢有一丝不满，不然将是真武圣地的灭顶之灾
“帝一”
凌浩座在宫殿的主座上，轻声道
“是，神子”
帝一恭敬道，便将威压撤去
真武圣地道场上的众人才得以喘上气，每个弟子头上都留着冷汗，到现在还没有缓过来，这一次仿佛去了鬼门关走了一次
“谢大人”
武鸿升恭敬对虚空上的宫殿道，心中本想的攀关系的想法瞬间就打消了
“你就是这个地方的主吗？”
帝一看着脚下的武鸿升道，眼里充满了不屑
“是的大人，小的正是”
武鸿升尽管心里有多不满，但还是不敢表现出来，如同小狗一般答道，修仙世界，弱肉强食，这是钢铁般的规则
“神子，我们到了”
帝一转向宫殿恭敬的道
随着凌浩缓缓的从宫殿走了出来，每走一步，整个真武圣地的威压更强一分
随着出现在真武圣地众人眼前的是一个胜似摘仙，五官清秀，修长的身材，皮肤皙白，俊朗冷酷的脸蛋带有七分的娇嫩，身穿金白五爪金龙道袍的十岁孩子走了出来，俯视冷淡的看着脚下的真武圣地
下面的弟子再一次被凌浩的威压压到双膝跪地吐血
而在虚空之上的武鸿升以及圣地长老和圣女清芝儿不可置信的看着眼前的孩子，根本不敢相信在自己眼前的孩子竟然如此强大，单单气场就已经碾压自身，宛如人类面对上古神兽一般，颤抖着
“这是摘仙吗？这孩子生的如此俊晓”
清芝儿脸色红润的看着眼前的凌浩，内心却如同惊涛骇浪一般暗道，根本不敢相信自己看到
“我等恭迎大人”
武鸿升对着凌浩恭敬的道，武鸿升根本看不透眼前孩子的修为，自己合体后期巅峰在他眼前如同蝼蚁
“带路吧”
帝一冷冷的看着武鸿升道，对他们的威压减去几分
“是是是，大人请跟我来”
content_en:
Zhenwu Holy Land
A castle-like vehicle stands in the sky, surrounded by sixty-four golden-armored imperial guards. In front of the vehicle is the eight-headed ancient ferocious beast Qilin. Behind it is a palace with brilliant crystal walls, overlooking the entire Zhenwu Holy Land.
"Is this the adult from the upper world? It's so scary."
In the Zhenwu Dojo, countless disciples were so suppressed by this invisible pressure that they could not raise their heads and could only lower their heads and secretly say
Then the disciples with low cultivation level in Zhenwu Holy Land couldn't bear it and vomited blood and fell to the ground.
"Please show me your noble hand, sir."
When Wu Hongsheng saw his disciples falling down one after another, he looked at the empty palace and did not dare to feel dissatisfied, otherwise it would be the end of the Zhenwu Holy Land.
"Emperor One"
Ling Hao sat on the main seat of the palace and said softly
"Yes, Son of God"
As soon as the emperor said respectfully, he removed the pressure
Everyone in the Zhenwu Holy Land dojo was able to breathe. There was cold sweat on every disciple's head. They haven't recovered yet. This time, it felt like they had gone to the gate of hell.
"Thank you sir"
Wu Hongsheng said respectfully to the palace in the sky, and the idea of establishing a relationship was instantly given up.
"Are you the owner of this place?"
Di Yi looked at Wu Hongsheng at his feet, his eyes full of disdain.
"Yes, sir, that's right, little one."
Although Wu Hongsheng was dissatisfied, he still did not dare to show it. He replied like a puppy, in the world of cultivating immortals, the law of the jungle is the rule of steel.
"Son of God, we are here"
Emperor Yi turned to the palace and said respectfully
"Hmm"
As Ling Hao slowly walked out of the palace, with every step he took, the pressure of the entire Zhenwu Holy Land became stronger.
What appeared in front of everyone in the Zhenwu Holy Land was a ten-year-old child who was as good as picking an immortal, with delicate features, a slender figure, fair skin, and a handsome and cold face with seven points of delicacy. He was wearing a golden and white five-clawed golden dragon robe. He walked out and looked down at the Zhenwu Holy Land under his feet coldly.
"Poof"
The disciple below was once again suppressed by Ling Hao's pressure and fell to his knees and vomited blood.
Above the void, Wu Hongsheng, the elders of the Holy Land, and the saint Qingzhi'er looked at the child in disbelief. They couldn't believe that the child in front of them was so powerful. The aura alone had already crushed them, just like human beings facing ancient mythical beasts, trembling.
"Is this picking up immortality? This child was born so handsome."
Qing Zhi'er looked at Ling Hao in front of her with a rosy face, but she secretly thought like a turbulent sea, she couldn't believe what she saw.
"I'll be waiting to welcome you, sir."
Wu Hongsheng said respectfully to Ling Hao. Wu Hongsheng could not see through the cultivation level of the child in front of him at all. The peak of his late-stage integration was like an ant in front of his eyes.
"Lead the way"
Di Yi looked at Wu Hongsheng coldly and said, reducing his pressure on them a bit.
"Yes, yes, sir, please come with me."
